out_of_sample_w10.note: Sixth blind week, second straight loss. The standing pick (rating 0.25x, pff_ytd 0) took W10 from 10.14 to 12.77 (+2.62); the new fit-best (0.5/0) gave 12.02. Hindsight best on the W10 grid was the live line again. Blind run: -0.7, -2.3, -2.1, -0.8, +3.6, +2.6 (net +0.3, the shrink is now net worse out of sample). W9 falsify rule met.

ablation.caveat: Descriptive. Layers correlated; single drops overstate each. Sandmoney decides weights, Brett approves.

candidate_changes.evidence: No W10 game at 8+ (JAX@TEN 7.7 was the largest). Cumulative 3/17; bucket MAE 15.02 vs 7.85.

Murray OUT priced 0.28 (Madden auto) for the second straight week; the W9 fix did not land. This week a 1.5 floor would have moved MIN@GB ~1.2 toward GB and added error (MIN won by 20 with Cousins). The fix is about consistency, not this result.

Backup sides vs close W10 2/4 (SEA, MIN yes; NYG, BAL no), W3–W10 10/23.
